migration_flags.description: The stored rate field direction in res.currency.rate.rate is unchanged from v16/v17. It represents units of the foreign currency per 1 unit of the reference base currency. No migration conversion needed for rate values.

v19 introduces company_rate and inverse_company_rate as computed+inverse fields on res.currency.rate. These replace direct editing of the raw rate field in the UI. Migration scripts writing to rate records should use the raw rate field, not company_rate.

Rate records can only be created for root companies, not branch/child companies. A validation constraint enforces this. Any migrated rate data with company_id pointing to a branch company will fail validation.

The account module blocks increasing the rounding factor (reducing decimal places) on currencies already used in accounting entries. Migration must not reduce decimal precision for currencies with existing journal entries.
DB unique constraint (name, currency_id, company_id) prevents duplicate rate entries for the same date. Migration data deduplication required before insert.

key_findings.rate_lookup_fallback: Latest rate on or before date -> oldest rate -> 1.0
key_findings.rate_storage_direction: Units of foreign currency per 1 unit of reference base (unchanged from v16/v17)
key_findings.thb_specifics: rounding=0.01, decimal_places=2, position=after, no special overrides in Community
key_findings.multi_company: Rates always on root_id company; branch companies forbidden from having rates
key_findings.base_currency_rate: Defaults to 1.0 via COALESCE fallback in _get_rates()
key_findings.account_extension_adds: Rounding change protection + temporary currency table for historical/average/current reporting rates
key_findings.new_in_v19: company_rate, inverse_company_rate computed+inverse fields on res.currency.rate; rate_string display field on res.currency

gate_rationale: All claims grounded in directly read source lines. No fabrication. Both source files fully examined. Migration flags identified with pointers.
